channel.description: Recent content in Projects on WIMMEL Portfolio Website

item.title: GraphWar Line Generation Program
item.description: Developed a Python program that automatically generates piecewise mathematical functions from user clicks to create precise projectile trajectories in the game Graph War.

item.title: KSC75 Headphones Detachable Cable Mod
item.description: Designed and implemented a custom 2-pin detachable cable modification for KSC75 headphones using 3D printing and soldering, enhancing durability and user convenience.

item.title: Automatic Door Opening System
item.description: Designed and developed an Arduino-based automatic door system with sensor integration, achieving 90% cost reduction compared to commercial solutions.

item.title: Moai Keycaps
item.description: Designed and 3D-printed custom Moai keycaps by modifying and combining existing models, achieving proper fit and functionality across multiple keyboard types.
